recordFormat.provenance: source: { origin: "explicit" | "auto" } only; no session id, turn, or quoted source
recordFormat.deletion: memory_forget removes the record; no tombstone or deletion marker is written

gapsAgainstT20: No per-record session/turn source: T20 requires "带时间与来源"; only explicit/auto origin is stored.
No deletion tombstone: forget is a hard delete, so v1.1 extraction has no marker that outranks old conversations.
Writes bypass ctx.study: its own memory_* tools and /memory/api routes write JSONL outside study.db, so requestId idempotency, revision, and change_log do not apply (AGENT invariant 1).

Deployment needs a profile package installation; scripts/project-config.mjs can only write patch YAML and the launcher never installs profile dependencies, so the zero-code route needs writes outside T20 ownership (launcher/profile manifest/release packaging).
Adds a second third-party business plugin (PLAN 3.1 says one business plugin), with 6 model tools, its own panel routes, and a bundled vector subsystem (disabled here).
Its tests are upstream-only; nothing runs in `node --test plugins/study/tests`, so regressions are invisible to this project.
decision: local implementation in plugins/study/host/modules/memory.mjs; the candidate is not installed in the shipped desktop profile
